current_git_boundary.authority: Direct owner instruction, 2026-11-14: make provenance local-only and push removal
current_git_boundary.identity_policy: Original/current paths, hashes, classifications and historical as-run evidence remain unchanged; no local bytes deleted or history rewritten.
current_git_boundary.verification: Default skips absent local archives explicitly; --check-local requires all registered bytes. Earlier Git-boundary facts below are historical.

authority: Direct owner instruction: Move all provenance archives under .provenance in the root. Update links in documents where necessary.
scope: Physical provenance archive consolidation and current-reference/tooling updates only; no source status, application, protocol or proof changes.

moves.private_ignored: Only specification-snapshots/; public-snapshots/ and reviews/ retain existing public-history scope.

identity.original_path: Preserved unchanged; source identity is not overwritten by physical relocation.
identity.previous_path: Pre-consolidation physical path retained for every registered payload.
identity.current_path: Updated to .provenance/ for every registered payload.
identity.documentation_ledger: docs/registers/documentation-archive.json retains previous_archive_path alongside new archive_path.

reference_policy: Current local Markdown links and register current-location fields updated. Original-path/source-text fields, ZIP members, archive bytes, frozen manifests and as-run JSON evidence preserved. Historical links inside frozen archives retain their original context; the provenance index and relocation map resolve former roots.

git_boundary.os_metadata_policy: The previously ignored, unindexed architecture-review/.DS_Store remains local_only and byte-identical. No force-add or retention reclassification.
git_boundary.publication: No staging, untracking, branch, commit, push, history rewrite or release. Existing public-history paths remain recoverable through Git history; private payloads remain local.

checks.method: Compare every moved payload SHA256 and byte count before/after relocation; separately compare auxiliary README

checks.command: uv run --with 'PyYAML>=6,<7' --with 'jsonschema>=4.18,<5' python -m unittest discover -s tests

checks.comparison: Exact failure lines match the before-move baseline; no source hash/path/ZIP-member errors.

checks.method: Check every registered payload with git check-ignore --no-index
Verify a temporary public-only copy with private archives and OS metadata absent
checks.cleanup: Temporary copy removed; no Git initialization/index mutation.

checks.note: Existing CSV quoting, unmodified fields and CRLF line endings preserved.

limits: No application/build/browser/Lean rerun required or claimed for this archive-only change.
Historical archive links/path strings are intentionally not rewritten inside byte-frozen payloads.
The optional retained-source-body checker had 30 pre-existing findings before this move; source identity and archive hash checks are separate from editorial body comparison.
Local evidence logs and private archives are not promised available in a public checkout.
